div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HT boosting is enabled,
a tank needs boosting outside its HT stall lockout,
DHW is flowing to the consumers, and their supply
exceeds that tank by more than ht_boosting_minimum_delta

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
no tank left that HT may boost,
the supply margin is lost, or DHW flow stops

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
high-temperature boosting becomes unavailable,
heatpump boosting is enabled, and a tank needs
boosting outside its heatpump stall lockout

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
heatpump boosting is enabled,
high-temperature boosting is unavailable,
and a tank needs boosting outside its heatpump stall lockout

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
no tank left that the heatpump may boost,
or heatpump boosting is disabled

p.br:
• close the boosting valves
• stop the pump
• disable pump flow control
On exit
• start the pump

• open the high-temperature source valve
• hold pump flow at ht_boosting_flow_setpoint
On exit
• disable pump flow control

• open the heatpump source valve
• start the heatpump at heatpump_temperature_setpoint
• hold pump flow at heatpump_flow_setpoint
On exit
• stop the heatpump
• disable pump flow control
